tv_trade_league_create_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_league_founder
	if = {
		limit = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_league_member }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_league_member value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_international_organizations_member_of = {
					international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
					leader_country ?= scope:tv_trade_league_founder
				}
			}
		}
		create_international_organization = {
			type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_to_international_organization = prev
				set_leader_country = prev
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
}

	# dyes
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_io
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_world_total value = 0 }
	every_country = {

			limit = { goods = goods:dyes }

	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_dyes value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_dyes value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_dyes value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_dyes > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_dyes value = var:tv_trade_io_dyes }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_dyes divide = var:tv_trade_global_dyes }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_dyes >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_dyes value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_dyes add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_dyes value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_dyes }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_dyes multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_dyes > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_dyes value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_dyes value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_dyes divide = 0.5 } }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_dyes value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_dyes divide = 0.5 } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_dyes value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_dyes >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_dyes add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_dyes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_dyes >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_dyes add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_dyes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_dyes >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_dyes value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_dyes add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_dyes value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_dyes }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_dyes divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_dyes value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_dyes }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_dyes subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_dyes }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_dyes < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_dyes value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_dyes >= 1
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_dyes >= 1
		}
		tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_dyes_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_monopoly_dyes < 1
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_dyes < 1
			}
		}
		tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_dyes_effect = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_dyes >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_dyes >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_dyes ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:dyes amount = { value = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_dyes } }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_dyes >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_dyes ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_dyes ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_dyes
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_io

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_cocoa value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cocoa value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_cocoa > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cocoa value = var:tv_trade_io_cocoa }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cocoa divide = var:tv_trade_global_cocoa }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_cocoa >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_cocoa value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cocoa add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_cocoa }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_cocoa value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_cocoa divide = 1 } }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_cocoa value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cocoa divide = 1 } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cocoa >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_cocoa }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cocoa >= 1 }

	}
	if = {

	}

	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_cocoa divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa }

	if = {

			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cocoa >= 1
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cocoa >= 1
		}
		tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_cocoa_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_monopoly_cocoa < 1
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cocoa < 1
			}
		}
		tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_cocoa_effect = yes
	}

	if = {

			}

				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target

							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target

						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_paper value = var:tv_trade_io_paper }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_paper divide = var:tv_trade_global_paper }

			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_paper >= 0.51 }

			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_paper add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_paper value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_paper }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_paper multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_paper > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_paper value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_paper value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_paper divide = 0.5 } }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_paper value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_paper divide = 0.5 } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_paper value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_paper >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_paper add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_paper }
	}
	if = {

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_paper value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_paper }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_paper divide = 100 }

		}
		tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_paper_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {

				var:tv_trade_monopoly_paper < 1

			}
		}
		tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_paper_effect = yes
	}

	if = {

							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

	# wool
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_io
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_world_total value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		every_trade = {
			limit = { goods = goods:wool }

		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_wool value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_wool value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_wool value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_wool > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_wool value = var:tv_trade_io_wool }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_wool divide = var:tv_trade_global_wool }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_wool >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_wool value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_wool add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_wool value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_wool }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_wool multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_wool > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_wool value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_wool value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wool divide = 1 } }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_wool value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_wool divide = 1 } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_wool value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wool >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_wool add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wool }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_wool >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_wool add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_wool }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_wool >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_wool value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_wool add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_wool value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_wool }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_wool divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wool value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_wool }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wool subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_wool }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wool < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wool value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wool >= 1
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wool >= 1
		}
		tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_wool_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_monopoly_wool < 1
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wool < 1
			}
		}
		tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_wool_effect = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_wool >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_wool >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_wool ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:wool amount = { value = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_wool } }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_wool >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_wool ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_wool ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_wool
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fish value = var:tv_trade_io_fish }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fish divide = var:tv_trade_global_fish }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_fish >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_fish value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fish add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fish value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_fish }

		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fish value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_fish value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_fish divide = 1 } }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_fish value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_fish divide = 1 } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fish value = 0 }

	}
	if = {

		}

	}

	if = {

						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
